text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper presents a non-review, original research study focused on land use land cover (LULC) prediction for China at the national scale. It integrates global socioeconomic and emission scenarios into a scenario-based assessment framework combining GCAM and FLUS models to project LULC changes from 2010 to 2100. The study implements multiple future scenarios (eight scenarios combining SSPs and RCPs), includes spatially explicit downscaling to 1 km resolution with quantitative accuracy assessment metrics (e.g., kappa coefficient, figure of merit), and provides mapped LULC projections for the entire country. The primary objective is explicit LULC prediction/simulation with scenario comparison and spatial modeling. It does not meet any exclusion criteria such as being global-only without national disaggregation, lacking spatial explicitness, or being purely qualitative. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria and is categorized as OK.)
